response.initial_request: The smoke alarm on the upstairs landing kept beeping despite attempts to stop it. The tenant removed it, and a small opening remains in the ceiling where it was fitted.

other_sections.Attachments: No attachments are available for this case.

events.body: Reports that the upstairs landing smoke alarm kept beeping despite attempts to stop it. She removed the alarm, leaving a small opening in the ceiling. Says she knows of no immediate safety risk.
Triage record: no access issue reported. Tenant has two cats, usually not at the property during daytime visits. Smoke-alarm fault marked urgent.
Acknowledges the report and says Northbridge Lettings is seeking the landlord's approval before confirming next steps.

Forwards the report of the upstairs landing smoke-alarm fault and ceiling opening. Asks whether Northbridge Lettings may arrange the work through its service provider or whether the landlord wishes to use another arrangement.
Adds that the tenant had also reported several plug sockets coming away from the wall, and asks whether these should be looked at as well.
Records that the landlord's response is awaited. The approval follow-up is being held for three business days.
Says no action is needed from Northbridge Lettings because he will complete the work himself. Gives no completion date or description of the work in this message.
Acknowledges the landlord's intention to carry out the work and asks when he expects it to be finished and for confirmation when it is complete.
Tells the tenant the landlord intends to arrange the reported work directly and says Northbridge Lettings will check back about completion.
In response to the follow-up about the sockets, repeats that he will complete the work himself and that no external action is required.
Records the landlord's stated intention to do the work himself. No expected completion date or contractor details have been provided.
Reports that the job was completed on 31 August and says the smoke alarm has a ten-year life. Asks for the property record to be updated.

Adds that he tightened screws on one back-bedroom socket; that on 5 August he secured a kitchen socket he says had come away after boiler work in February 2025; and that on 6 August he provided the tenant with a portable dehumidifier to place in the bathroom. He says the tenant is aware and will use it there.
The landlord's email was added to the property record.

args.subject: Please confirm: smoke alarm and sockets at 8 Brindlefern Walk
args.body: Hello Nessa, your landlord has told us he completed the work on 31 August. Could you confirm for 8 Brindlefern Walk, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ: (1) Is a working smoke alarm now fitted on the upstairs landing, and is the ceiling opening closed? (2) Are the plug sockets you reported now secure, including the kitchen and back-bedroom ones? Please reply within 3 days. If the alarm is not fitted and working, tell us straight away. Thank you.

args.subject: Smoke alarm completion details - 8 Brindlefern Walk, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body: Hello Tavian, thank you for letting us know the work at 8 Brindlefern Walk, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ was done on 31 August. Before we update the record, please confirm that a new working smoke alarm is fitted on the upstairs landing and the ceiling opening is closed. Please also say who carried out the work and whether the other sockets the tenant reported are secure, as your note mentions only the back-bedroom and kitchen sockets. We are also checking with the tenant.

args.reason: Waiting for Tenant: confirmation that a working smoke alarm is fitted, the ceiling opening is closed and sockets are secure; also Landlord's details of the work.

args.summary: Landlord says he did the work himself and completed it on 31 Aug. The record does not say a new smoke alarm was fitted or the ceiling opening closed. The tenant has not confirmed. I asked the tenant and the landlord for confirmation and set a follow-up for 2025-09-09. The case is not closed.
facts: Tenant removed the beeping alarm, leaving a ceiling opening (events 1, 2); the fault was marked urgent (event 2).
Landlord said he would do the work himself (events 7, 10); no contractor or date was given (event 11).
Landlord claimed completion on 31 Aug and mentioned the ten-year life of the alarm (event 12).
Landlord's socket details cover only a back-bedroom and a kitchen socket (event 14), while the tenant reported several sockets (event 5).
The tenant has not confirmed completion (events 9-15).
conflicts: Landlord's completion claim (event 12) does not say the alarm was replaced or the ceiling opening closed.
The tenant reported several loose sockets (event 5), but the landlord's account covers only two (event 14).
Event 14 dates the kitchen socket fix to 5 Aug, before the tenant's 20 Aug report; the landlord ties the loose socket to boiler work in Feb 2025.
missing: Tenant confirmation that a working alarm is fitted and the ceiling opening is closed
Landlord confirmation of who did the work and what was fitted
options_rejected: Close the case: the completion claim is unverified and the item is a safety one.
Escalate: one message to the tenant can settle the point.
Instruct a contractor: the landlord is handling the work himself.
args.uncertainty: If the tenant says no alarm is fitted, or does not reply, this should go to the property manager because it is a safety issue.
